name: model-upload-simple
description: Simple ladder for the model-upload feature: verify the Upload entry point is present in the catalog in Simple mode (modelUpload is a simple-tier flag), then drive the group-detection pipeline over a synthetic 60-group folder via the dev-only __detectGroups hook and assert it detects 60 groups + 2 loose models with the progress callback reaching the total. The paginated dialog render itself (React.lazy, unmountable headless) is covered by GroupPanel.test.tsx + pageWindow.test.ts.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode — expected uiMode=simple
